jobs.title: Data Analyst
jobs.description:
About The Company

L3Harris Technologies is a leading defense technology company committed to delivering innovative solutions that enhance national security and defense capabilities. With a focus on cutting-edge advancements in space, air, land, sea, and cyber domains, L3Harris is dedicated to providing mission-critical systems and services to government and commercial clients worldwide. The company fosters an inclusive and engaging environment that promotes professional growth, values diversity, and emphasizes community involvement. Fundamental to its culture are principles of integrity, excellence, and a relentless pursuit of technological innovation to meet the evolving needs of its customers.

About The Role

We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Specialist, Software Engineer/Data Analyst to join our dynamic team in Melbourne, FL. This role is integral to modernizing and migrating analytics applications into high-performance, web-based solutions utilizing contemporary web technologies. The successful candidate will hold an active TS/SCI clearance and may be required to periodically commute to Patrick Space Force Base. The position offers an exciting opportunity to work on mission-critical systems supporting national security operations. The ideal candidate will possess a strong background in full-stack development, cloud computing, and data analysis, with a passion for developing secure, scalable, and innovative applications that directly impact national defense initiatives.

Qualifications

The ideal candidate will have a minimum of a Bachelor's Degree with at least four years of relevant experience. Alternatively, a graduate degree coupled with a minimum of two years of related experience or eight years of experience without a degree will be considered. An active TS/SCI security clearance is mandatory. Candidates should demonstrate a strong foundation in software engineering principles, cloud platforms, and data analytics. Certifications such as Security+ or DoD IAT Level II are preferred or must be obtained within six months of employment. Candidates should also possess excellent communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with multidisciplinary teams.

Responsibilities

Design, develop, test, and maintain full-stack applications, including user interfaces, backend services, APIs, and data integrations to support mission-critical operations.
Create modern, responsive, and user-friendly front-end solutions leveraging current web development frameworks and best practices.
Develop secure, scalable backend services and application logic to support complex workflows and data processing needs.
Deploy and manage applications within AWS environments, ensuring solutions are resilient, scalable, and cost-effective.
Integrate cloud-native services, databases, and application components across distributed environments to optimize performance and security.
Apply best practices in software engineering throughout the development lifecycle, including code reviews, automated testing, version control, and continuous integration/continuous deployment (CI/CD).
Collaborate with system engineers, cloud engineers, cyber teams, and mission stakeholders to define requirements and deliver comprehensive solutions.
Engage regularly with customers to understand operational needs, gather feedback, and refine application functionalities accordingly.
Develop architectural designs, implementation plans, and technical roadmaps aligned with organizational and mission objectives.
Produce detailed technical documentation covering system design, architecture, deployment procedures, and sustainment activities.
Present technical briefings and professional presentations to stakeholders, translating complex concepts into clear, actionable insights.
Support various mission areas, adapting to changing priorities within a dynamic operational environment.
Maintain familiarity with the C2S Access Portal (CAP) and high-side AWS environments, ensuring compliance and security standards are met.
Work with relational and non-relational databases such as PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server, and DynamoDB.
Ensure application security and compliance, supporting the integration of security protocols and certifications as required.

Benefits

L3Harris offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to support the well-being and professional development of its employees. Benefits include competitive health insurance options, retirement plans, paid time off, and flexible work arrangements. Employees have access to ongoing training and development programs to enhance their skills and advance their careers. The company promotes a healthy work-life balance and provides resources to foster a supportive and inclusive workplace environment. Additionally, employees are encouraged to participate in community service initiatives and corporate social responsibility programs, reinforcing L3Harris’s commitment to making a positive impact beyond the workplace.

Equal Opportunity

L3Harris Technologies is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment where all employees and applicants are treated with respect and dignity. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, age, national origin, ethnicity, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, veteran status, disability, genetic information, citizenship, or any other characteristic protected by law. We maintain a drug-free workplace and conduct pre-employment substance abuse testing and background checks where permitted by law. Many positions require the ability to obtain a security clearance, which is only available to U.S. citizens. By applying, you consent to our sharing your information with affiliates for employment consideration and understand your rights under applicable employment laws.

jobs.title: Project Coordinator in the Corporate Workspace Design Furniture Industry
jobs.description:
Are you an experienced project coordinator, in the corporate workspace design furniture industry, who is looking to join an expanding, dynamic organization? Do you want to work for a company that believes that people with a purpose need great spaces to perform their best work. Do you thrive in a fast-paced and growing environment where your contributions are valued and where you can see the immediate impact of your work? If you have the vision and motivation to help grow our business, then we want to hear from you!   

Be.Workplace Design is looking for a talented and experienced
Contract Furniture Industry Project Coordinator who can provide high-level support to customers and our internal sales organization.  Someone who can prepare, process and coordinate customer orders. We are looking for someone with superior technical skills and an understanding of the order fulfillment process. Someone who wants an opportunity to change their lifestyle and do something that they are proud of.

Bring your talent and skill to a place where you are a true contributing member to our highly personal and collaborative approach. Using the latest technologies and best practices, we work closely with our clients to define their goals, develop solutions, and create change.

Overview: 

This position is responsible for the entire sales order fulfillment process, including management of customer orders from order entry point through punch list. Providing support to sales personnel, an accurate and timely service to customers. Coordinates order entry, order management, factory interface and close-out of orders. Possess the desire to achieve a high level of professionalism through continuous improvement processes and practices.

Specific Responsibilities and Duties:

Customer Service
Communicates with customers regarding order status, punch list resolution and the scheduling of orders for delivery/installation.
Provides clarifications and answers for customer’s questions regarding order issues.

Order Preparation
Assists sales/project personnel in pricing, product research and technical order information (C.O.M. requirements, custom requirements, etc.)
Assists sales with the preparation of the quotation; reviews quote and prints it for sales presentation to customer.
Reviews and proofs order for basic information (ship to, bill to, contract number, etc.), accuracy and completeness.
Enters orders into computer system; sends purchase orders to manufacturers.

Sales Order Management
Disperses order information to appropriate internal and external personnel (sales staff, operations customer, etc.).
Checks acknowledgements against order; resolves discrepancies with factory; sends acknowledgement to customer; verifies ship date with customer.
Reviews receiving information from field operation and matches to order; resolves discrepancies before approval and sending to payables; enters receiving information into sales order system.
Invoices customer for product delivered and work performed; verifies invoice amounts and balance to customer’s P.O.
Enters orders for punch list/warranty work; follows up to ensure all punch list work is done in a timely manner. 

Work Order Management
Prepares work order packet and delivers packet to operations.
Provides schedule information to dispatcher.
Initiates service quotes for deliveries, small orders, and major orders (if required).

File Control
Maintains master sales order and work order files, ensuring file is complete and up-to-date.

Project/Account Coordination
Initiates and oversees deliveries and small installations; provides order management on all work, including large projects.
Analyzes order requirements, details scope of work, requests service pricing and schedules work with dispatcher for deliveries and small installations.
Interfaces with factory on order status, current lead times, reservation of manufacturing for future/project orders, specials requirements, C.O.M. requirements, etc.
Communications with customer on schedule of work, site requirements and project parameters for deliveries and small installations.
Manages factory interface and shipping coordination for all work.
Oversees delivery and small installation task completion.

Sales/Work Order Close-Out
Maintains and files customer signoffs for all assigned sales/work orders.
Invoices for all product and service work for assigned sales/work orders.
Is responsible for punch list resolution, including ordering product and initiating work order; follows up to ensure timely completion of punch list work. 

Skills, Knowledge, Experience Required:

3 to 5 years of customer service work experience – preferred.
3 to 5 years of experience with dealership business systems- preferred.
3 to 5 years of contract furniture industry experience – preferred. 
Ability to learn and apply technical skills in dealership business systems.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office software (Excel, Word, Outlook).
Experience using the CORE management system is a plus.
Prior experience successfully managing multiple projects simultaneously in a fast-paced work environment.
Excellent and effective oral and written communication.
Strong organizational, analytical, and administrative skills.
Ability to see the big picture and integrate into day-to-day tasks and activities.
Fluid interpersonal skills to interact effectively with a wide range of customers, personnel, and departments.

Compensation & Benefits: 

Base pay: $65K to $85K + bonus plan based on experience.
40 Hours of vacation year one and 80 hours in years two through five.
9 paid holidays.
Medical, Dental and Vision Insurance.
Safe Harbor Matching Contribution Plans.
401K & Roth IRAs.

Are you interested in making a difference in the lives of fellow Californians while achieving your career goals? Do you set high standards for yourself and enjoy a collaborative and challenging work environment? The mission of the California Department of Social Services is to serve, protect, and support the people of California experiencing need in ways that empower wellbeing and disrupt systemic inequities. The vision of the California Department of Social Services is to provide quality services with a commitment to an inclusive, diverse, and equitable California where all people can thrive.

The California Department of Social Services (CDSS) launched the Research, Automation and Data Division (RADD) to build a sustainable data culture and maximize the full value of CDSS data assets. RADD is responsible for working with Information Services (technology) and Program partners throughout the data life cycle to ensure best practices are elevated toward the goal of serving California's most vulnerable families using a human-centered and data-driven approach.

CDSS Guiding Principles

Diversity. Equity. Inclusion. Accessibility. Belonging.
We ensure opportunities for everyone to participate in a meaningful way in fulfilling the mission and vision of CDSS.

Community Engagement
We prioritize the lived experiences of community members as a driving force behind the creation, implementation, desired impact, or change of programs and services.

Empowerment
We engage, operate, and advocate from the understanding that each community and person have desires and capabilities to lead in their own life.

Quality Services
We provide services that align intent and impact by ensuring that they are accessible, community driven, interconnected, and continuously improved.

Data Defined Outcomes
We equitably collect and analyze data, take data-driven action, and measure outcomes relevant to those we serve, ensuring transparency and accountability.

Job Description And Duties
Do you love creative problem solving? Are you passionate about social services and motivated to ensure that benefits are provided to millions of Californians quickly and efficiently? If so, this position might be perfect for you.

Our team helps CDSS programs to make data-driven decisions and perform tasks faster so that more Californians can access the support they need. As an RDA II in the Data Solutions Unit, you will participate in meetings with programs to learn about their data problems and help build solutions to address them. Common examples of our work include modernizing data collection, automating workflows, and creating low-code apps that simplify complex processes.

The key to succeeding in this role is a willingness to learn, both about CDSS programs’ needs and new technical skills. A successful RDA II will acquire a deep understanding of programs’ processes, the ability to identify pain points, and the technical skills to create innovative solutions.

The specific solutions we create vary by project and our software options are growing, so flexibility and the capacity to learn through shadowing, meetings, project documentation, and online trainings are more important for this role than preexisting knowledge. All work will be done under the direction of the RDS I Supervisor and in conjunction with other team members as the RDA II learns our developing technology stack and how it can be used to serve CDSS programs.

jobs.title: Colony Manager Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
Join the forefront of groundbreaking research at the Beckman Research Institute of City of Hope, where we're changing lives and making a real difference in the fight against cancer, diabetes, and other life-threatening illnesses. Our dedicated and compassionate faculty and staff are driven by a common mission: Contribute to innovative approaches in predicting, preventing, and curing diseases, shaping the future of medicine through cutting-edge research.

We are looking for an Animal Breeding Program Coordinator who will work under the supervision of the Animal Breeding Program Supervisor to plan, implement, and monitor the breeding of animals for biomedical research. You will assist the Breeding Supervisor with training, task assignment, and monitoring the performance of technicians assigned to breeding activities. You may also assist with husbandry/breeding and other technical support functions as required.

As a successful candidate you will:

Serve as the primary liaison between Comparative Medicine (CCM) staff and research teams, collaborating with investigators to develop strategic breeding plans and ensure production goals are met through effective colony management.
Manage all aspects of breeding colony operations, including mating selection, genotyping, phenotyping, breeding performance, weaning, and colony maintenance, while providing ongoing communication and support to research groups to ensure project success.
Interpret and apply NIH guidelines, institutional animal care policies, and all applicable federal, state, and local regulations to ensure compliance and uphold the highest standards of animal welfare and research integrity.
Train and support breeding, husbandry, and research staff on animal breeding practices, colony management, and troubleshooting breeding challenges, while facilitating the onboarding and development of new breeding projects.
Establish, maintain, and oversee breeding databases, record-keeping systems, and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), ensuring accurate data management, regulatory compliance, and operational efficiency across the animal breeding program.

Your qualifications should include:

Associates degree or extensive course work in animal science, biology, veterinary technology, or a related field. Bachelor’s degree is preferred.
2 additional years of experience plus the minimum experience requirement may substitute for minimum education.
Practical training in breeding colony management practices is required.
AALAS Learning Library Transgenic Training Program Courses on Breeding and Colony Management offered by Charles River Laboratory, Jackson Laboratory or any other Educational Training is preferred.
Thorough knowledge of animal husbandry, handling, restraint, breeding techniques, regulations, and concepts of animal welfare

Required Certifications/Licensure (Must Have One Of The Qualifications Below)

AALAS Laboratory Animal Technologist (LATg) certification with 4 years of related animal care experience which includes breeding colony management and animal husbandry
LAT certification with 5+ years of animal breeding experience
ALAT certification with 10+ years of animal breeding experience managing breeding colonies

jobs.description:
Grow Therapy is on a mission to serve as the trusted partner for therapists growing their practice, and patients accessing high-quality care. Powered by technology, we are a three-sided marketplace that empowers providers, augments insurance payors, and serves patients. Following the mass increase in depression and anxiety, the need for accessibility is more important than ever. To make our vision for mental healthcare a reality, we’re building a team of entrepreneurs and mission-driven go-getters. Since launching in February 2021, we’ve empowered more than ten thousand therapists and hundreds of thousands of clients across the country and insurance landscape. We’ve raised more than $328Mm in funding, including our Series D, at a $3B valuation from Sequoia Capital, Transformation Capital, TCV, SignalFire, Menlo Ventures, Goldman Sachs Alternatives, and others.

The Opportunity

We are looking for a Data Analyst to help us drive data-driven insights and reporting in Product at Grow Therapy, and who will work on a variety of reporting, analytics and experimentation projects. You’ll join a broader data organization of analysts, data scientists, and data engineers, and be part of an Analytics team reporting into an Analytics Manager. This role will support our Lives Covered product group.

What You’ll Be Doing

Partner with Product and other technical stakeholders to prioritize analytical needs and support product launches, decision-making, and ad hoc requests through clear, data-driven insights
Develop, maintain, and evolve core product and performance reporting, including business-critical dashboards built on scalable, reliable datasets
Support experimentation and A/B testing through thoughtful design, execution, analysis, and clear, actionable conclusions
Create compelling data visualizations and storytelling assets to effectively communicate insights to diverse audiences
Collaborate with senior and staff analysts on complex, high-impact analytical projects, including data modeling and OKR development
Work closely with data scientists and data engineers to improve data availability, integrity, accuracy, reliability, and logging/pipeline quality

You’ll Be a Good Fit If

You have 3+ years proven experience in using analytics to tackle business problems that cross multiple product/project areas and teams, ideally in a high-growth, fast-paced environment.
You have strong SQL skills and intermediate understanding of experimental design (such as A/B experiments).
You are a wizard at building business critical dashboards/data visualizations (ideally within Hex or Looker, with strong LookML expertise)
You have experience with data modeling (dbt) or are eager to learn
You love data storytelling, creating a compelling narrative by extracting insights from data, and summarizing learnings / takeaways for executives.
You enjoy communicating effectively and building relationships with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
You deeply value the importance of expanding access to mental health care.

Power BI experience is strongly preferred, particularly the ability to visualize remediation plans, progress, risks, and outcomes. Lead the end-to-end remediation plan for a large data governance backlog, including intake, prioritization, sequencing, status tracking, risk identification, and follow-through on deliverables.
Identify and prioritize key tables that require governance artifacts based on usage, business value, data sensitivity, reporting dependency, and readiness for broader enterprise consumption.

Perform other duties as assigned.

experience, including the ability to create dashboards that communicate plan, progress, risk, backlog burn-down, artifact completion, and adoption readiness.

or governance platforms.

A prioritized inventory of key tables requiring governance remediation is established and actively managed.

The analyst demonstrates the SQL, Power BI, and storytelling capabilities needed to support a potential shift toward a broader BI role.

The Company

Plenary Americas is a leading specialized developer of long-term Public-Private Partnership (PPP) projects. Since inception in 2005, we have built a portfolio of approximately 65 projects and more than USD $41 billion / CAD $54.5 billion in North American assets under management. Why work for Plenary?

Our focus is on empowering our employees, driving results, building strong camaraderie, and celebrating our wins as a team. Our workplace culture is like no other and is our driving force to bring infrastructure to life. Learn more about us by visiting www.plenaryamericas.com

The Role

The Project Coordinator will play a key supporting role in the successful coordination and execution of infrastructure projects within the P3 environment during design, construction, and facilities management phases. Working closely with project leadership and cross-functional teams, the role will assist with project administration, reporting, meeting coordination, document control, stakeholder engagement activities, and tracking of key deliverables across active projects. The role will support multiple projects, including two local projects within the region such as the Prince George’s County Public Schools Blueprint Phase II project and the University of Maryland NextGen Energy Program.

Responsibilities

Project Coordination & Delivery
Serve as an integral member of the project management team, supporting Design, Construction, Operations and Asset Management while coordinating with cross-functional teams as required.
Coordinate project team schedules, meetings, submittals, and document control including preparation of meeting agendas, minutes, and tracking of action items and deliverables.
Support project coordination activities associated with local projects, including site visits and stakeholder meetings as required.
Assist project management team with ad hoc tasks relating to projects.

Stakeholder & Contract Support

Liaise with clients, partners, contractors and other project related personnel and effectively communicate relevant project information to ensure a seamless operation of the project throughout all project phases.
Support all aspects of contract management including notices, change and purchase orders, warranties and any on-site coordination.
Manage change order database and advise Project Managers of the status and any issues impacting client relations.
Monitor deliverables, quality of work and pricing with contractors and other service providers.

Reporting & Documentation

Prepare and distribute project related correspondence including reports, letters, RFIs, presentations and other confidential communications.
Prepare change order documentation for client and subcontractors.
Prepare standardized templates for project documentation and tracking
Ensure the adherence of project control procedures and maintain all project related documentation.

Qualifications

Post-secondary education in Business, Project Management, Engineering or other design/construction related courses.
2+ years of working experience in project coordination – specifically within construction, facility management or P3 projects.
Excellent verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills
Strong knowledge of Microsoft Office and excellent writing and editing skills.
Effectively manage multiple projects of varying size and complexity under tight deadlines.
Strong work ethic and high level of personal and professional integrity.
Work positively within a cohesive team to achieve the common goals.
Knowledge of construction and/or facility management processes and terminology is preferred.
Experience using Sharepoint and scheduling or project management software would be an asset.

This role offers the opportunity to work on major infrastructure projects that have a lasting impact on communities, while gaining exposure to all aspects of the P3 project lifecycle and collaborating with multidisciplinary teams across project delivery, operations, and corporate functions. Competitive salary with annual bonus potential.

Job Description

JOB TITLE: High School Program Coordinator

LOCATION: Partnership 4 Kids

EMPLOYMENT CLASSIFICATION: FT or PT / Hourly or Non-exempt

SUPERVISOR: Senior Program Director

JOB PURPOSE:
Supports Partnership 4 Kids goal and objectives by developing implementing and managing program criteria.

Essential Job Functions

Program Facilitation - Plans, coordinates, and facilitates year-round programming to support the agency’s mission and goals. Provides a safe and secure environment for relationship development and learning. Communicates with students, parents/guardians about meeting schedules and provides reminders to maintain a high level of retention. Identifies translation needs for target schools.
Student Lesson Plans – Supports agency objectives by contributing information and recommendations for curriculum planning. Prepares lesson plan guidelines and handouts and notifies students, mentors, and school administrators of meeting logistics.
Program Outreach and Student Recruitment – Cultivates and builds relationships with students, teachers, school administration, volunteers, and corporate partners to further P4K’s mission. Serves as a liaison between the organization and target middle/high schools and maintains regular communication with school officials and partnering programs in those schools,. Works closely with program staff across different grade levels to ensure students transition seamlessly into the program continuum. Participates in student recruitment activities. Maintains communication with school officials and agency staff on the recruitment process.
Youth/Family Case Management & Engagement Opportunities – Provides case management based on expectations to support academic goals, attendance barriers, and identify resources within the school and surrounding community with assigned students. Case management and other engagement activities may be conducted at the school, P4K office, the student’s home, or other approved locations or venues.
Volunteer Support – Provides guidance and communication to all volunteers involved in year-round programming. Follows P4K Match Support Guidelines and Program Coordinator expectations as set forth in agency policies and procedures. Facilitates ongoing mentor and student engagement year-round. Communicates with the supervisor and recruitment staff to identify volunteer needs or issues in a timely manner. Provides recognition to mentors and solicits feedback.
Program Data Management – Maintains accurate and timely documentation of student and match-related information in agency databases. Following program policies and procedures to ensure the safety of all participants is of the highest priority. Notifies Program Director and appropriate authorities immediately of any child safety issues or abuse/neglect allegations. Competent computer skills in Microsoft Office are required.
Team & Agency Goals – Contributes to programming, development, volunteer, and agency goals. Including, special projects/events and all other duties as assigned. Attends relevant required job training. Must be able to work evenings and weekends as needed.

Job Requirements (knowledge, Skills, And Abilities)

Bachelor’s degree preferred or relevant work experience in the areas of human service or education.
Minimum of one year’s experience working with at-risk youth of relevant age groups in an after school or school-based environment.
Previous volunteer management, teaching or classroom experience preferred.
Demonstrates effective written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills.
Daily access to a reliable vehicle for travel to meetings and transporting youth, as needed. State minimum liability insurance requirements must be maintained for the duration of employment. Driver’s license and acceptable driving record must be maintained throughout employment. Refer to the employee policy and procedure manual for a complete list of acceptable driving information and requirements. Program Coordinators will be required to drive 10-15 passenger van for various events and outings.
